newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $107/dressed, passed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $107/dressed, passed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle were bid $107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis but the bids were passed by owners asking $108.00, market sources said.
The packer bids were fully steady with late sales of $107.00 near the end of Wednesday's active trading.
About 80,000 head had been sold this week in Nebraska, which exceeded this week's estimated showlist of 72,000, the sources said.
"We basically sold everything we had to sell," a source said.
Price strength was linked to strong beef demand and feedlots being current in their marketings.
